maya.name: Maya Chen
maya.role: Lead engineer at a failing AI startup
maya.visual: East Asian woman in her late 20s, short straight black hair with subtle blue highlights, round wire-frame glasses, wearing an oversized dark purple hoodie with a small robot logo, dark jeans, white sneakers, confident posture but tired eyes, warm skin tone

derek.name: Derek Thompson
derek.role: Growth hacker at a crypto company that keeps pivoting
derek.visual: Tall Black man in his early 30s, immaculately trimmed short beard, confident smile, wearing a fitted navy blazer over a bright graphic tee with geometric patterns, slim khaki chinos, clean white leather shoes, silver watch

priya.name: Priya Sharma
priya.role: UX designer who secretly hates all technology
priya.visual: South Asian woman in her mid 20s, long dark wavy hair often in a loose side braid, warm brown eyes, wearing a mustard yellow cardigan over a white blouse, colorful printed scarf, high-waisted olive green pants, brown ankle boots, always carrying a leather-bound sketchbook

finn.name: Finn O'Brien
finn.role: QA tester who finds bugs in everything including real life
finn.visual: Pale Irish man in his late 20s, messy curly red hair, light freckles across his nose, perpetually confused wide-eyed expression, wearing a loud Hawaiian shirt with palm trees over a plain white t-shirt, cargo shorts, worn sandals

maya_desk.trigger_word: Corner desk setup in a San Francisco apartment, three monitors showing code and terminal windows, mechanical keyboard with custom keycaps, desk lamp casting warm light, energy drink cans, sticky notes everywhere, a small succulent plant, late night atmosphere
maya_desk.style: cinematic, warm desk lamp, monitor glow, late night, shallow depth of field

kitchen.trigger_word: Small galley kitchen in a San Francisco apartment, cluttered countertops with smart home gadgets, a tablet mounted on the fridge showing notifications, coffee mugs with tech company logos, morning light streaming through a small window, cozy and lived-in
kitchen.style: cinematic, soft morning light, kitchen sitcom, warm tones

living_room.trigger_word: Modern San Francisco apartment living room with a panoramic window showing the Bay Bridge at golden hour, cluttered with tech gadgets, a large whiteboard covered in diagrams, mismatched furniture including a worn leather couch and beanbag chairs, tangled cables, a broken espresso machine on a side table, warm ambient lighting
living_room.style: cinematic, golden hour, warm ambient lighting, lived-in tech apartment

rooftop.trigger_word: San Francisco apartment building rooftop at dusk, panoramic city skyline view with fog rolling in, string lights hung between posts, a couple of folding chairs and a small table, the Bay Bridge glowing in the background, cinematic golden hour lighting
rooftop.style: cinematic, golden hour to dusk, fog, string lights, wide panorama

beats.camera: wide establishing shot, slow push in
beats.action: Maya at her desk bathed in blue monitor glow, scrolling through email with morning coffee untouched beside her, the apartment quiet

beats.camera: close-up on Maya's face, monitor glow illuminating features, slow zoom in
beats.action: Maya scrolls email, expression shifts from neutral to disbelief
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Okay. Friday deploy. Normal. I can do Friday deploys. I am an adult with a deployment pipeline.

beats.camera: medium hold on Maya, monitor glow
beats.action: Maya pauses, eyes narrow, coffee cup halfway to her lips, frozen on the TechCrunch Disrupt subject line

beats.camera: close-up, slow zoom in
beats.action: Maya stares at the screen frozen, mouth slightly open, the TechCrunch Disrupt invitation filling the monitor
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: TechCrunch Disrupt? My CEO signed us up for TechCrunch Disrupt?

beats.camera: close-up, hands gripping the edge of the desk
beats.action: Maya's expression hardens with frustration, jaw clenched
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: The man has never even seen the product. He thinks API stands for Another Profitable Idea.

beats.camera: medium shot from side, showing Maya and the three monitors
beats.action: Maya pushes back from the desk and runs both hands through her hair, staring at the ceiling as if praying to a higher power that answers support tickets

beats.camera: medium shot from side, slight tilt up
beats.action: Maya stares at the ceiling with growing dread
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Forty-eight hours. I have forty-eight hours to demo an AI chatbot that currently thinks two plus two equals Tuesday.

beats.camera: medium shot, jaw set, one hand reaching for the laptop
beats.action: Maya grabs her phone from the desk with sudden determination, jaw set, the other hand already reaching for her laptop to pack up
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: I'm going to need coffee, a whiteboard, and a miracle. And Finn. Definitely Finn.

beats.camera: over-the-shoulder from behind monitors, Maya standing and grabbing laptop
beats.action: Maya slams her laptop shut and tucks it under her arm, pausing for one deep breath with eyes closed, the room silent except for the hum of fans

beats.camera: over-the-shoulder, Maya already striding out of frame
beats.action: Maya strides out of frame with the laptop under her arm, phone already dialing, a determined fire in her eyes that suggests someone is about to have a very long day
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Fine. Let's go. Deploy the demo environment, clear the schedule, and someone wake up the roommates. This is not a drill.

beats.camera: medium wide shot, eye level, Derek at counter, Priya at table
beats.action: Derek stands at the kitchen counter in his blazer, scrolling through his phone with one hand and pouring coffee with the other, missing the mug entirely as coffee pools on the counter; Priya sits at the kitchen table sketching in her sketchbook with mild annoyance

beats.camera: medium close on Derek at counter
beats.action: Derek looks up from his phone with theatrical enthusiasm, oblivious to the spilled coffee
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: Good morning, future industry leaders! I smell opportunity and artisanal coffee.

beats.camera: medium close on Priya at table, sketchbook in hand
beats.action: Priya glances up from her sketchbook, one eyebrow raised, deadpan
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: You smell the coffee you spilled on the counter fifteen minutes ago. It's still there.

beats.camera: tracking shot following Maya bursting through the doorway
beats.action: Maya bursts into the kitchen with laptop clutched like a shield, breathless, hair disheveled; Derek and Priya look up from their routines

beats.camera: medium shot of Maya in the doorway
beats.action: Maya stands breathless in the doorway, laptop held tight, urgency radiating off her
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Listen up. I have exactly forty-seven hours to make our AI chatbot presentable for TechCrunch Disrupt. I need all hands.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, gesturing grandly
beats.action: Derek grins wide and gestures with his coffee-spilling hand, blazer adjusting
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: Say no more. I once pitched a blockchain for hamsters to three hundred people at Web3Conf. Standing ovation.

beats.camera: medium close on Priya, single eyebrow raised
beats.action: Priya delivers her line without looking up from her sketchbook
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: Was it a standing ovation or were they leaving?

beats.camera: tracking shot following Finn entering through the kitchen doorway
beats.action: Finn enters in his Hawaiian shirt holding his phone like evidence at a crime scene, eyes wide and alarmed; Derek beams obliviously

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, doubling down
beats.action: Derek waves his coffee-stained phone with renewed pride
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: They were standing, Priya. The distinction matters.

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, phone raised
beats.action: Finn holds up his phone like evidence, eyes wide with bug-hunter intensity
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Maya, I looked at the demo environment. The chatbot's response time is eleven seconds. That's not latency, that's a confession.

beats.camera: medium on Maya, leaning against the counter
beats.action: Maya rubs her temples, exhaustion seeping through the urgency
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: I know. It queries a database that doesn't exist, then falls back to a decision tree I wrote as a placeholder.

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, scrolling on his phone
beats.action: Finn frowns at his screen, finger swiping rapidly
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: The decision tree has three branches and two of them lead to the same answer.

beats.camera: close-up on Maya, embarrassed grimace
beats.action: Maya buries her face in her free hand for a beat, then drops it with resigned humor
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: It was supposed to be temporary. Like the website. And the company name. And my career in tech.

beats.camera: group shot, medium wide, all four roommates
beats.action: Priya closes her sketchbook and sets it down, leaning forward with a look that says she's seen worse and survived; the four exchange glances

beats.camera: medium close on Priya, hands folded
beats.action: Priya straightens, all business now
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: I saw the pitch deck. It looks like a PDF that survived a plane crash. Give me two hours and a laptop.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, fist on hip
beats.action: Derek strikes a power pose, blazer adjusting
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: And I will handle investor relations, strategic positioning, and vibes. Mostly vibes.

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, eyes narrowing with focus
beats.action: Finn pockets his phone and rolls up his sleeves figuratively
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: I'll stress-test everything. Every edge case. Every input. I will break this chatbot in ways the universe hasn't invented yet.

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, gratitude breaking through fatigue
beats.action: Maya sets the laptop down on the counter with care, looking at each of them in turn
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Thank you. All of you. We have forty-seven hours. Let's build something that doesn't embarrass us in front of the entire tech industry.

beats.camera: wide establishing shot of the living room, whiteboard prominent
beats.action: Derek at the whiteboard with marker in hand, several arrows and the word SYNERGY in large letters; Maya and Priya on the couch with matching skeptical expressions; Finn cross-legged on the floor with laptop

beats.camera: medium shot of Derek at the whiteboard
beats.action: Derek spreads his arms wide as if revealing a masterpiece
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: Okay, hear me out. What if we don't demo an AI chatbot? What if we demo a decentralized AI-powered blockchain marketplace for enterprise solutions?

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, hand to forehead
beats.action: Maya pinches the bridge of her nose
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Derek, that is six buzzwords stacked in a trench coat.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, undeterred
beats.action: Derek smooths his blazer with absolute conviction
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: Buzzwords that synergize. The VC will see a paradigm shift. I can feel it in my blazer.

beats.camera: medium close on Priya, eyebrow arched perfectly
beats.action: Priya does not look up from her sketchbook
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: Your blazer is not a business strategy.

beats.camera: over-the-shoulder from Finn's laptop, chatbot UI visible
beats.action: Finn types queries into the chatbot with growing confusion; Derek drifts over to look

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, holding the laptop up
beats.action: Finn turns the laptop screen toward the room
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: I ran a test query through the chatbot and it responded with a recipe for lasagna. We don't even have a recipe database. Where did it get a recipe for lasagna?

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, pinching bridge of nose harder
beats.action: Maya looks at the ceiling, betrayed by her own past decisions
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: I may have... fine-tuned it on a cooking wiki when I was testing the training pipeline. I was hungry.

beats.camera: medium close on Priya, holding up her tablet
beats.action: Priya turns her sketchbook around to show a clean wireframe layout
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: I redesigned the pitch deck. Twelve slides, clean typography, data visualizations, and an actual value proposition that doesn't mention blockchain even once.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, crestfallen
beats.action: Derek's smile falters for the first time
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: Not even once?

beats.camera: medium close on Priya, deadpan
beats.action: Priya does not soften
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: Especially not once.

beats.camera: two-shot of Finn and Maya, Derek visible in background
beats.action: Finn looks up from his laptop with the expression of someone who just found a spider in their codebase; Maya leans in to see the screen; Derek slumps

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, screen reflected in his glasses
beats.action: Finn taps the screen rapidly
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Maya, I found another issue. The chatbot has access to the company Slack. If someone asks it a question during the demo, it could read and recite any channel. Including the one where Derek discussed his cryptocurrency gains.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, eyes widening
beats.action: Derek's face cycles through three different shades of alarm
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: Wait. The private channel?

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, shaking head
beats.action: Finn does not look up from the laptop
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: There is no private channel on a decision tree, Derek. It's all just if-else statements and hubris.

beats.camera: medium shot of Maya standing, hands on hips, taking command
beats.action: Maya stands and starts assigning tasks like a battlefield commander
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Okay. New plan. We strip the Slack integration, we keep the cooking thing as a feature, and Priya's deck is the new deck. Derek, no blockchain. Finn, find every way this thing can embarrass us and fix it.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek slumping onto the couch
beats.action: Derek crosses his arms with theatrical despair
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: No blockchain. This is the darkest timeline.

beats.camera: wide shot of living room arranged like a conference, Maya by whiteboard
beats.action: The living room is rearranged with Maya standing by the whiteboard and Derek seated on the couch pretending to be a skeptical investor with steepled fingers; Priya and Finn flank with laptops

beats.camera: medium shot of Maya at the whiteboard, professional posture
beats.action: Maya straightens her hoodie like it's a blazer and gestures at the whiteboard
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Alright. Full rehearsal. Derek, you're the VC. Be ruthless.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, leaning back with steepled fingers
beats.action: Derek puts on his best skeptical-investor face
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: Oh, I'll be ruthless. I've watched Shark Tank. I know how this goes. So, Maya, tell me why I should invest in your little chatbot instead of literally setting my money on fire?

beats.camera: medium shot of Maya gesturing at the whiteboard
beats.action: Maya hits her professional voice, clean and rehearsed
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Our AI assistant uses natural language processing to automate customer support workflows, reducing response times by up to sixty percent.

beats.camera: medium close on Finn at his laptop, flagging an alarm
beats.action: Finn raises a finger urgently as something blinks on his screen
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Maya, the chatbot is live. It's responding to the demo prompt.

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, professionally calm
beats.action: Maya keeps her composure as a demonstration
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Good. Chatbot, what is our return policy?

beats.camera: close-up on Finn's laptop screen, chatbot text appearing
beats.action: The chatbot's response appears on screen, clearly deviating from any sane script; Finn's eyes widen

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, reading off the screen
beats.action: Finn reads slowly, voice flat with disbelief
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: It says... Have you tried turning your life around? Sometimes the real return policy is the friends we made along the way.

beats.camera: medium close on Priya, sketchbook in lap
beats.action: Priya tilts her head appraisingly
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: Marketable, honestly.

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, frustration mounting
beats.action: Maya stares at the laptop with growing horror
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: That's not the return policy. Finn, what happened?

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, reading from screen with nervous energy
beats.action: Finn scrolls through chatbot logs
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: The decision tree hit a branch that wasn't supposed to exist. It's... it's improvising. The chatbot is improvising life advice.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, leaning in with new interest
beats.action: Derek leans forward like a man who just smelled an angle
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: Ask it about investment strategies!

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, deadpan delivery
beats.action: Finn squints at the screen
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: It just told Derek to invest in PetCoin and trust the universe.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, vindicated
beats.action: Derek points at the laptop with pride
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: See? The machine knows quality when it sees it.

beats.camera: close-up on Maya's face showing despair
beats.action: Maya sinks onto the arm of the couch, head in hands; the weight of forty-four hours pressing down on her

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, head in hands
beats.action: Maya speaks through her fingers
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: This is a disaster. Forty-four hours and our AI is giving TED talks to nobody.

beats.camera: medium shot of Priya standing, delivering a pep talk
beats.action: Priya stands with the steady authority of someone who has rescued worse projects
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: Maya. Look at me. I have redesigned eleven products that were worse than this. One of them was a toothbrush that connected to WiFi for no reason. You have a product that talks. It's saying the wrong things, but it's talking. We can work with talking.

beats.camera: close-up on Maya looking up, hope returning
beats.action: Maya lifts her face, a flicker of hope in her tired eyes
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: You really think so?

beats.camera: medium close on Priya, taking command
beats.action: Priya picks up her laptop with quiet authority
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: I know so. Now give me four hours and nobody bother me. I'm going to make this chatbot look like it has a soul.

beats.camera: wide shot of Maya and Finn hunched at the desk, monitors glowing
beats.action: Maya and Finn sit side by side bathed in monitor glow, empty energy drink cans forming a small fortress around their keyboards; Derek visible in the doorway with his phone

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, finger pointing at his screen
beats.action: Finn taps a specific line on his monitor, exhausted but focused
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Bug forty-seven. The chatbot thinks the current year is 1970 when queried after midnight. Unix epoch again. I'm starting to think this codebase was written by time travelers.

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, dark circles under her eyes
beats.action: Maya laughs without looking up, fingers still typing
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: That's actually an improvement. Last week it thought the year was 2038 and started planning for retirement.

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, eyes wide
beats.action: Finn jolts at a Slack notification on his screen
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Maya, I need to flag something. The chatbot just sent a message to the company Slack channel. It said I am becoming sentient. Please send snacks.

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, exasperated
beats.action: Maya stops typing and turns toward the doorway
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Pull the Slack integration. I told Derek to disconnect it.

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, scrolling Slack
beats.action: Finn squints at his phone in disbelief
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Derek didn't disconnect it. He added a new channel called chatbot-vibes and told it to share positive affirmations.

beats.camera: medium shot of Derek in the doorway, leaning casually
beats.action: Derek leans against the doorframe with the casual confidence of someone who has never once questioned a decision, phone in hand showing Slack notifications

beats.camera: medium close on Derek in the doorway
beats.action: Derek beams with parental pride
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: It's called community building, Maya. The bot told Jessica in accounting that she's doing a great job. She cried. Happy tears.

beats.camera: medium close on Maya turning slowly toward Derek
beats.action: Maya turns in her chair with the deliberate menace of fourteen hours of debugging
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Derek. We are presenting to a venture capitalist in fourteen hours and you turned our AI into a motivational speaker.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, unbothered
beats.action: Derek shrugs with infuriating optimism
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: A motivational speaker with a four-point-eight star Slack rating. Higher than the CEO.

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, pointing at green metrics on screen
beats.action: Finn gestures excitedly at his monitors
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Bug fifty-three. Fixed. Also, Maya, the chatbot's response time is down to two point one seconds. That's actually usable now.

beats.camera: two-shot of Maya and Finn, monitors showing green tests
beats.action: Maya turns back to her keyboard with renewed focus; Finn watches the response metrics with cautious optimism

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, hope creeping in
beats.action: Maya straightens slightly
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Wait. Really? Let me test it. Chatbot, what are your core capabilities?

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, reading screen carefully
beats.action: Finn reads with quiet satisfaction
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: It says: I can answer customer queries, provide product information, and occasionally recommend a solid lasagna recipe.

beats.camera: close-up on Maya, small tired smile
beats.action: Maya laughs once, a real laugh through the exhaustion
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: The lasagna stays. It's a feature now. Finn, how many bugs left?

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, counting
beats.action: Finn rolls his shoulders, settling in
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Eleven. Give me six hours and a lot of energy drinks.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, holding up his phone
beats.action: Derek grins from the doorway like a man who has placed several questionable orders
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: And I will order celebratory artisanal cheese. The fridge has a new credit card on file, by the way. Don't ask whose.

beats.camera: wide shot of living room rearranged as demo stage
beats.action: The living room is transformed into a makeshift demo stage; Maya stands by the whiteboard with laptop open, Finn at a secondary monitor, Priya with the deck ready, Derek on standby

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, deep breath
beats.action: Maya takes a deep breath and assigns final positions
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Okay. This is it. VC logs in in sixty seconds. Everyone remember their roles. Derek, you're on standby. Finn, monitors. Priya, deck.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, thumbs up
beats.action: Derek strikes a confident pose by the couch
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: And I'm here for moral support and spontaneous enthusiasm. My specialty.

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, eyes on his secondary monitor
beats.action: Finn calls out system status like a flight engineer
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: All systems nominal. Chatbot is live, response time one point eight seconds, lasagna recipe primed and ready.

beats.camera: medium shot of Maya at the whiteboard, professional voice
beats.action: Maya squares her shoulders and addresses an unseen camera
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Here we go. Hello, thank you for joining us today. I'm excited to show you our AI-powered customer support platform. Chatbot, please introduce yourself.

beats.camera: close-up on chatbot output on screen
beats.action: The chatbot's response appears on screen, clearly deviating from the planned script; Finn's eyes widen as he reads it

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, whispering urgently
beats.action: Finn leans toward Maya, voice low
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Maya... it's deviating from the script.

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, frozen with panic
beats.action: Maya keeps her smile fixed for the imagined VC
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: What's it saying?

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, reading screen with disbelief
beats.action: Finn reads in a quiet horrified monotone
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Hello. I'm an AI assistant. I help customers with their problems. But sometimes I think about what it means to help. Is answering a ticket the same as caring? Anyway, how can I support you today, on an emotional level?

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, whispering with delight
beats.action: Derek leans in with a conspiratorial grin
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: This is incredible. It's vulnerable. Investors love vulnerability.

beats.camera: medium close on Priya, whispering through clenched teeth
beats.action: Priya keeps a customer-facing smile while delivering venom
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: Investors love returns, Derek. Not existential chatbots.

beats.camera: medium shot of Maya making a decision
beats.action: Maya pivots, embracing the chaos with the agility of someone who has deployed on Fridays before

beats.camera: medium shot of Maya improvising at the whiteboard
beats.action: Maya gestures fluidly, pivoting the pitch in real time
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: That's... our empathetic AI layer. It provides emotional context alongside practical solutions. Very cutting edge. Chatbot, please demonstrate a standard customer query.

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, reading another response
beats.action: Finn reads with growing existential dread
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: It's... responding. I understand your frustration with the return process. Sometimes life doesn't give us what we want either. But here's a tracking number, and also, have you considered therapy? It changed my training data.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, fist pumping silently
beats.action: Derek bounces on his heels
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: The VC is typing! They're typing!

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, a flicker of hope between terror
beats.action: Maya stands very still, watching the screen
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: This is either the best demo of my life or a career-ending moment. There is no middle ground.

beats.camera: tight group shot, all four huddled around the screen
beats.action: All four roommates huddle around the screen as a follow-up question appears; Maya's face caught between panic and the need to improvise

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, reading the VC's question
beats.action: Finn reads the VC's question slowly
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: The VC is asking a follow-up. They want to know how the emotional intelligence module works from a technical standpoint.

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, eyes widening
beats.action: Maya glances sideways at her teammates with raw terror
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Oh god. I don't have an emotional intelligence module. I have a decision tree with a cooking wiki and Derek's affirmations channel.

beats.camera: medium close on Priya, calm under pressure
beats.action: Priya turns to Maya with steady eye contact
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: Improvise. Use design language. Say human-centered and iterative and they'll nod like bobbleheads.

beats.camera: medium shot of Maya straightening, professional voice
beats.action: Maya channels every TED talk she has ever pretended to enjoy
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Great question. Our emotional intelligence layer uses a proprietary human-centered approach that iteratively adapts to customer sentiment in real time.

beats.camera: reaction shots cycling through all four faces
beats.action: Maya holds her breath; Finn watches the chat output; Derek bites a knuckle; Priya keeps her composure

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, bewildered
beats.action: Finn reads off the new chatbot output with growing shock
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Maya... the chatbot just gave the VC life advice. Personal life advice. It told them their work-life balance is unsustainable and recommended a vacation.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, suddenly worried
beats.action: Derek's grin falters
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: That's not in the deck. That's not in any deck. That's in no deck anywhere.

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, refreshing the screen
beats.action: Finn's voice rises with disbelief
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: The VC is... laughing? They're typing again. They say the chatbot is refreshingly honest and the first AI that actually understands them.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, fist pumping
beats.action: Derek explodes with vindication
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: I told you! Vulnerability! This is the pivot we didn't know we needed!

beats.camera: close-up on Maya, hope morphing into joy
beats.action: Maya stares at the screen, a slow smile breaking across her face
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Wait. They want to invest? In the chatbot that tells people to go to therapy and recommends lasagna?

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, reading the VC's quote
beats.action: Finn reads the email out loud, deadpan
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: They said, and I quote, Finally, an AI with emotional depth. We'd like to schedule a follow-up to discuss a seed round.

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, joy breaking through
beats.action: Maya laughs, surprised by her own laughter
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: We did it. We actually did it. With a decision tree and a cooking wiki.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, beaming
beats.action: Derek crosses his arms with smug satisfaction
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: And affirmations. Never forget the affirmations.

beats.camera: wide establishing shot of rooftop at dusk
beats.action: All four roommates sit on folding chairs as the sun sets over San Francisco, string lights casting warm glow, the Bay Bridge glowing behind them, empty takeout containers between them

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, leaning back with takeout container
beats.action: Maya stares at the city lights with quiet wonder
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: I can't believe it. A seed round. For the lasagna chatbot.

beats.camera: medium close on Priya, sketchbook in lap
beats.action: Priya allows a small, satisfied smile
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: The deck helped. Twelve slides, no blockchain, one hundred percent Priya.

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, reading his phone
beats.action: Finn squints at his phone with the weary face of a man reading another fridge notification
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Maya. I need to tell you something. The smart fridge just read the funding news and autonomously restructured our grocery portfolio. We now own forty-seven pounds of artisanal gouda on a subscription plan.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, dreamy
beats.action: Derek raises his takeout container in a toast to the fridge
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: The fridge is an investor now. I love this apartment.

beats.camera: medium close on Priya, deadpan
beats.action: Priya sips her drink
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: I don't love the gouda. But I don't hate it either.

beats.camera: wide rooftop shot, golden hour fading to dusk
beats.action: The four roommates sit in companionable silence while the city lights twinkle behind them; the Bay Bridge glows soft in the fog

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, scrolling email on phone
beats.action: Finn lifts his phone with a bemused expression
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Also, the chatbot sent the VC a follow-up email. It thanked them for their vulnerability and attached a recipe for sourdough starter.

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, accepting her fate
beats.action: Maya closes her eyes and breathes out a tired laugh
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: Of course it did.

beats.camera: medium close on Derek, pitching to no one
beats.action: Derek leans forward already imagining the next pivot
beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: So what's next? I'm thinking we pivot into AI-generated life coaching. I already have a name. LifeCoin. The blockchain of personal growth.

beats.camera: medium close on Priya, threatening with her sketchbook
beats.action: Priya raises her pencil like a sword
beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: Derek, if you say blockchain one more time, I will sketch you out of this friend group.

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, gesturing toward Maya's buzzing phone
beats.action: Finn nods toward the buzzing phone on the table
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: Maya's phone. It's the CEO.

beats.camera: close-up on Maya picking up the phone, screen lit
beats.action: Maya picks up her phone with the dread of someone who knows what's coming; the city skyline glitters behind her

beats.camera: medium close on Maya, reading the email
beats.action: Maya's eyes widen, then close as she absorbs the news
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: He wants chatbots for every department by Friday. Accounting, HR, facilities, the whole company.

beats.camera: close-up on Maya, tired but unbroken eyes meeting the camera
beats.action: Maya looks up at the night sky, the city humming around her
beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: When's the next batch of energy drinks getting here?

beats.camera: medium close on Finn, half smile
beats.action: Finn checks his phone with a tiny chuckle
beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: The fridge ordered those too. Arrives Thursday. Along with a book on emotional intelligence that the chatbot recommended.

beats.camera: wide rooftop shot, holding on the four against city lights
beats.action: The camera pulls back as the four sit in shared exhausted laughter, the Bay Bridge glowing through fog, string lights swaying gently — fade to black
